scripts.pack:sdk: pnpm --filter @agent-commitments/network-config build && pnpm --filter @agent-commitments/sdk build && node scripts/pack-sdk.mjs

scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @agent-commitments/console test && pnpm --filter @agent-commitments/api test && pnpm --filter @agent-commitments/provider-example test && pnpm --filter @agent-commitments/document-workflow test && pnpm test:local-chain && pnpm test:browser-local-chain
scripts.test:browser-local-chain: pnpm --filter @agent-commitments/console build && pnpm --filter @agent-commitments/network-config build && pnpm --filter @agent-commitments/sdk build && forge build --root contracts && node scripts/browser-local-chain-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:local-chain: pnpm --filter @agent-commitments/network-config build && pnpm --filter @agent-commitments/sdk build && forge build --root contracts && node scripts/local-chain-e2e.mjs
scripts.example:testnet-readonly: pnpm --filter @agent-commitments/network-config build && pnpm --filter @agent-commitments/sdk build && pnpm --filter @agent-commitments/sdk-only-example example:testnet
scripts.example:circle-wallets: pnpm --filter @agent-commitments/network-config build && pnpm --filter @agent-commitments/sdk build && pnpm --filter @agent-commitments/circle-wallets-example example
